subject: Need help on displaying points in legend

messages.author: ea4e687a14dc225c
messages.subject: Need help on displaying points in legend
parts:
Hi all, Happy Christmas

Assume following code :

dat <- data.frame(x = rnorm(100))
point <- data.frame(
x = c(0,0),
y = c(1,0),
point.col = c("yellow", "green")
)

ggplot(dat) +
geom_histogram(aes(x = x, fill = ..count..)) + scale_fill_gradient
("Count", low = "blue", high = "red", legend = F) +
geom_point(aes(x, y, colour = point.col), data = point, size = 4) +
scale_colour_manual(values = c("yellow", "green"), legend=T)

This code is working fine. Now I want to name the 1st point (yellow
colored) as "Point-1" and the 2nd one (green colored) as "Point-2",
which needs to be displayed in the legend. Therefore I modified the
last line of previous code as :

scale_colour_manual(values = c("Point-1" = "yellow",
"Point-2"="green"), legend=T)

However in this case no point is being displayed. Where I am doing
mistake? I am using Version: 0.8.5.

Your help will be highly appreciated.

Thanks and regards,

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Need help on displaying points in legend
parts:
Hi Megh,
Does this do what you want?

point$point.col <- factor(point$point.col, levels=c("yellow",
"green"), labels=c("Point-1", "Point-2"))

geom_point(aes(x, y, colour = point.col), data = point, size = 4) +
scale_colour_manual(values = c("yellow", "green"), legend=T)

Hi Megh,
The thing to understand here is that the legend labels come from the
levels of the variable that the scale is mapped to. So all I did was
change the values of point.col to Point-1 and Point-2 instead of
yellow and green. You can see what I did just by looking at the
result. Try

point <- data.frame(
x = c(0,0),
y = c(1,0),
point.col = c("yellow", "green")
)

parts:
On a different note, judging by the way you put the colors in the data frame I thought that what you wanted was to use the colors in the data frame and add a legend with different labels.  Something like

df <- data.frame(
  x = c(0,0),
  y = c(0,1),
  col = c('green','yellow')
)
qplot(x, y, data = df, colour = col) + 
  scale_colour_identity()

But that removes the legend (even though scale_colour_identity() defaults to legend = TRUE).  Is that a bug?  Or, how do you even recover the legend?

Merry Christmas all
david.
